Join our manufacturing plant team in Riyadh as we transition from a startup environment into stable Business as Usual (BAU) operations. In this role, you will serve as a key on-site IT application support resource, helping ensure the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of business-critical manufacturing and plant applications. You will work closely with local and global teams to support production operations, resolve application issues, and contribute to operational transformation initiatives, including the adoption of AI-enabled solutions.
q: 2+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications in a business environment.
Experience within manufacturing operations and/or end-to-end supply chain environments.
Knowledge of relational databases such as PostgreSQL, DB2, or Oracle.
Familiarity with ITIL processes and Agile ways of working.
Experience using IT service management platforms such as BMC Remedy, Jira Service Management, or ServiceNow.
Understanding of application security, access management, monitoring platforms, and application performance monitoring tools.
Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, with fluent English communication skills. What Lenovo Can Offer You

d: Empower Future Problem Solvers as Our Middle School Math Teacher

Are you a dedicated educator passionate about making numbers come alive and helping students build a strong foundation in mathematical reasoning? As a Middle School Math Teacher, you will guide students in developing critical thinking, logical analysis, and practical problem-solving skills through engaging, real-world learning experiences.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Education with a major in Mathematics, or a related field.
Proven experience teaching middle school mathematics or working in a similar educational role.
Strong communication, analytical, and classroom management skills.
If you are enthusiastic about inspiring young minds to embrace challenges, think critically, and discover the power of mathematics, we encourage you to apply

Design and deliver dynamic math lessons that introduce core concepts in pre-algebra, geometry, algebra, and number sense, fostering a deep understanding of mathematical principles.
li

li
